risk_note: RV2-level (SMS sending costs money; same-IP hourly quota, BR-ID-05). POST /v1/landing/sms-codes goes live (unsigned, no device, no captcha; 20001 → 44001 → same-IP quota → phone quotas, purpose login). Round 7 model (orchestrator 2026-10-19 12:3x): PG table app.sms_send_attempts (migration 0052) is authoritative — admission under a per-(app, ip_hmac) advisory lock counts pending / unknown / accepted rows in [now−3600−send timeout, now] and inserts a pending row before the provider call; explicit provider rejection and pre-check refusals do not count; Redis is no longer counted. Round 8: the registration count read failure refuses (42901, Retry-After 1) instead of reading as 0; attempt status changes only through transitionSmsAttempt (pending → accepted | failed | unknown, terminal states final) under ops/approvals.yaml id 35 until the CT-04 generator. Orchestrator kept as is: setting() falls back to the 08 defaults on a config read failure (B1-03e §9.2), recordRegistered write failures only log (B1-03g frozen tests). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
